headers:
1. One manufacturer for the overall solution is to be submitted.
2. Only new product direct from the original manufacturer will be accepted.
3. File, freestanding and wall mounted storage units/shelves as well as their
interior drawers, shelves, etc. are to be steel.
4. Worksurfaces, file fronts and any other exposed surface that may be specified
as laminate, must be high pressure laminate (HPL).
5. Worksurfaces and tabletops must have a minimum of 2.0mm thick PVC edge
band (grain or solid color to match the top surface) on the proud side of the
surface that matches the primary laminate surface. Top: 1" - 1.25" Thick, High
Pressure Laminate.
6. Product must adhere to University of Minnesota requirement for 10 year
warranty direct from the manufacturer. This includes all parts, pieces and
components that make up a file or storage unit.
7. MUST list the typical lead time for product.
sample:
One manufacturer for the overall solution is to be submitted.
Bidder state system furniture manufacturer.

1. All products are preferred to be standard running line offerings to avoid
increased costs and delivery times when product is purchased in the future.
Bidder state any non-standard products.

The successful bidder will field verify the site and present adjustments for any
exceptions that need to take place.
Bidder MUST include allowance for field verification in their additional costs on
the Specification/Pricing form. Amount to be approriate for the size of the
building and the scope of work.
Bidder state total hours and total price included in bid for field verification.

headers:
Bidder is required to provide all parts, pieces and components necessary to
complete the demonstrated workstations and office layouts.
1. Pricing submitted per specification line item is to be the collection of all parts
and pieces necessary to complete the arrangement of the office/workstation
layout.
2. All worksurfaces are to be independent from each other and floor supported.
Worksurfaces are not to be mechanically fastened to under files units.
3.The successful bidder will be required to submit a line item list of all product
that comprises the order.
Bidder state acknowledgement.

Fiber core, fabric wrapped, no frame with horizontal mounting brackets for walls
and top mounted brackets for worksurfaces.
1. Base grade fabrics (i.e.., Grade 1, Grade A)
2. All sit/stand desks to have clearance between mounted bracket and edge to
have clearance for cord management and monitor arm mounts.
Bidder state:
1. Core material and thickness
2. Cut sheets for mounting brackets

minimum of 1 USB charging port.
